payload.claim: The docstring now claims collapsing `re-verify:` into its phase is 'what CONTEXT.md's checkpoint entry forbids,' but CONTEXT.md has no generic 'checkpoint' entry, only 'Plan checkpoint,' and that entry's own text and _Avoid_ list address only mislabelling the plan-writing step as a phase (e.g. avoiding 'PLAN'). It says nothing about PACKAGE, re-verify, or about PhaseStart's label/phase split, so citing it as the source of a rule covering `re-verify:` misstates what that vocabulary entry actually says. The rewording from the prior, more specific 'plan-checkpoint entry' to the vaguer 'checkpoint entry' also drops the exact vocabulary term CLAUDE.md requires citing precisely.
